svg.aria-label: raw-native: Render on the CPU, then check the fast AO shortcut against ray tracing. A bright point on a surface. On the left, rays fan out and some stop on a hatched box; on the right, sample dots sit over a stepped depth profile. Below, a strip of dots of varying size, the error, and the readout RMSE 0.1349 / TOL 0.1200, REFUTED.
